purpose: Visual and UX reference for OPD1 Tracker. Stack, API contracts, and repository architecture remain governed by AGENTS.md and the source.

outcome_score.usage: Only the large score inside OutcomeBadge.

ascii.usage: ASCII Studio content and controls only.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use border-white/10 for shared surfaces and list rows.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use shadow-panel for drawers, popovers, and tooltips; shadow-modal for modal dialogs.
visual_enhancers.translucency: In-app translucency is allowed. Never enable OS-level window transparency.
visual_enhancers.blur: Use backdrop-blur-panel on panels, drawers, popovers, and tooltips; backdrop-blur-modal on modals. Never use backdrop blur on list rows.
visual_enhancers.radius: Use rounded-xl for overlays and rounded-lg or rounded-md for controls and rows.

component_guidance.list_rows: min-h-[88px], border-white/10, translucent surface without backdrop blur.
component_guidance.outcomes: Keep win, loss, draw, and unresolved distinct. Use OutcomeBadge sizes consistently.
component_guidance.player_names: Constrain live player names to 160px and frequent teammate names to 180px; use Truncate tooltips.
component_guidance.alerts: Use a yellow warning pill and AlertTriangle for smurf or boosting signals; put detailed reasons in tooltips.

accessibility.interactive: Provide visible focus rings, collision-aware overlays, Escape/outside-click closing, and focus restoration.

media.valorant_assets: Load VALORANT imagery only from media.valorant-api.com.
media.fonts: All fonts are packaged locally; no external font requests.

design_notes_for_agents: Do not change the Flask backend for visual redesign work.
Every interactive element and key informational wrapper must have a data-testid.
Design Mode must remain guarded by import.meta.env.DEV.
Real data only; demo payloads must never be presented as live data.
